entries.title: Mercury v1.5.5
entries.note: ☿ Mercury Agent v1.5.5 Devices sign in with a device token, Mercury asks you for what only you can do, and bots use fewer tokens. Devices sign in with a device token Password sign-in from other devices is now off by default. To connect a phone, Mercury Desktop or a browser on another computer, make a token on the computer Mercury runs on: /server token (or mercury devices add ), and paste it in. Devices already signed in keep working. Turn password sign-in back on with /server password on . /server is easier: add allowed addresses by typing them, copying a token closes the token screen, and in Mercury Desktop /server opens its own Remote access window. Mercury asks you for what only you can do CAPTCHAs, codes, a step on a website: Mercury sends it to every chat you've connected (Telegram, WhatsApp, Signal, Discord, Slack), Mercury Desktop and your phones, with the image, and waits. entries.title: CAPTCHA Solver 0.1.0
entries.note: New plugin. Install with /plugins install captcha , or Plugins → CAPTCHA Solver → Install in Mercury Desktop. Needs Mercury 1.5.5 or newer. Cheapest first. Your own vision models read simple image CAPTCHAs for free; two must agree before an answer is used. A solving service with your key handles reCAPTCHA v2/v3 (Enterprise too), Cloudflare Turnstile, GeeTest and FunCaptcha: 2Captcha by default, or CapSolver, Anti-Captcha or CapMonster. Solved tokens come with a script that puts them into the page. A daily limit caps paid solves. You, as the last resort. If nothing else can, the CAPTCHA goes to your chats, Mercury Desktop and your phones, and the plugin waits for your answer (up to 4 minutes). Also captcha__detect (finds CAPTCHAs on a page) and captcha__balance .

entries.title: Mercury v1.5.4
entries.note: ☿ Mercury Agent v1.5.4 Set up voice from your phone, and fewer approval prompts. Voice from any device Set voice keys from your phone , with or without Optimus: OpenAI, Gemini, ElevenLabs, Deepgram and more. Mercury checks each key before saving it. A key is never shown back to a device, only its last four characters. One place for keys. A key saved from the phone, Mercury Desktop or Optimus is the same key everywhere. Fewer prompts Only plugin installs ask from another device. Changing a plugin's settings, like Optimus's voice, and setting voice keys no longer ask for your approval. Both are still recorded in the audit log. Fixes A setting changed from a phone no longer snaps back when the plugin takes a while to restart. Install Desktop: mercuryagent.sh/download · Mac: curl -fsSL https://mercuryagent.sh/install-desktop.sh | sh Server / CLI: curl -fsSL https://mercuryagent.sh/install.sh

entries.title: Mercury v1.5.3
entries.note: ☿ Mercury Agent v1.5.3 Ready for Mercury on your phone, Google Workspace in one command, and bots that can't be steered by what they read. Mercury on your phone The native iPhone and Android apps connect to this release. They aren't in the app stores yet. Real-time voice calls. The phone gets a short-lived token from your Mercury and runs Mercury's own voice engine, so a call answers in about two seconds. Your API keys never leave your computer. Calls hear you, not the room. Background talk and noise don't count as you speaking. Live dictation types your words into the message box as you speak, with OpenAI, Deepgram or ElevenLabs. Chat lists show a preview of each chat's last message. Google Workspace mercury google connect connects Gmail, Drive and Docs. It installs Google's gws tool, pinned and checksum-checked. It signs you in to your own Google account. It adds Mercury's Google Works

entries.title: Optimus 0.5.2
entries.note: Plugin-only update. Install or update with /plugins update optimus , or Plugins → Optimus → Update in Mercury Desktop. Works with Mercury 1.3.9 and newer; screenshot sizing per model needs Mercury 1.5.2. Screenshots sized for the model in use. Optimus resizes each capture to what the model reads best: Claude and OpenAI 1024×640, Gemini 768×480, open vision models 896×560. Click coordinates stay exact. No screenshot for models that can't see images. Optimus says which window is in front instead of sending a picture the model can't read.

entries.title: Mercury v1.5.2
entries.note: ☿ Mercury Agent v1.5.2 Watch your bots work live, approve things one at a time, and get complex jobs done properly. Chats run at the same time, memory keeps one copy of each thing, and text Mercury reads can't steer it. Getting real work done Complex chat work follows Mercury Code's rules. Once the chat makes a plan: it acts instead of announcing; it checks what it made before calling it done; when a tool fails, it fixes the cause or asks, never quietly switching methods. Commands run on Mercury's own Node. Node tools like HyperFrames no longer fail on an older system Node. A video that never rendered isn't sent as finished. A video that's all black, or never moves, is caught before it goes out. Plans keep up. A forgotten last tick is completed. entries.title: Mercury v1.5.1
entries.note: ☿ Mercury Agent v1.5.1 Reading aloud and voice typing now use the voice you chose, Gemini included, and the Optimus update button tells you what it did. Speech Your voice choice counts everywhere. Reading a reply aloud, voice typing and voice notes from Telegram or WhatsApp use the voice service chosen in Settings → Voice when it has a key. A fresh install with only a Gemini key no longer asks for an OpenAI key. Gemini speaks and listens. Gemini reads replies aloud (about 4 seconds for a sentence) and transcribes what you say, with the same key Optimus uses. A Gemini model that's busy or retired falls through to the next one. The "needs a speech service" notice points to Voice settings and names every option (Gemini, OpenAI, Deepgram, ElevenLabs) instead of an "Add OpenAI key" button. Mercury Desktop "Update Optimus" says what happened on the microphone & permissions card: updated, n

entries.title: Mercury v1.5.0
entries.note: ☿ Mercury Agent v1.5.0: Mercury Desktop Mercury now has a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux. It runs Mercury on your computer or connects to Mercury on a server, keeps itself and your servers up to date, and asks you before anyone new gets in. Mercury Desktop (new) One app for chat, code, bots and research. It installs and starts Mercury on this computer for you, or connects to any number of Mercury servers and switches between them from the top bar. Download it at mercuryagent.sh/download . This first release isn't code-signed yet: macOS asks you to allow it once (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway), Windows SmartScreen once (More info → Run anyway). On a Mac, curl -fsSL https://mercuryagent.sh/install-desktop.sh | sh installs it with no prompt. entries.title: Optimus 0.5.1 (plugin update)
entries.note: Plugin-only update. Install or update with /plugins update optimus , or Plugins → Optimus → Update in Mercury Desktop. Mercury itself is unchanged; works with Mercury 1.3.9 and newer. Microphone & permissions on every OS. Mercury Desktop's Optimus page shows the microphone, Accessibility and Screen Recording state at the top, with a microphone picker, a live voice-level test and an off switch. Checks the microphone before a voice session , so a blocked microphone says so instead of a silent session. The macOS permissions check now includes the microphone. Desktop voice controls from 0.5.0: start from Mercury, live transcript, voice levels.
